text.p: Pen pictures of the probable 1860 Munich team for Sunday's German first division clash with Bayern Munich.

Rainer Berg. Goalkeeper. Age 31. Big keeper who, at 1.94 metres, even towers over Bayern counterpart Oliver Kahn. Enjoying a new lease of life in his second spell at 1860, relegating previous first-choice Bernd Meier to the bench
Bernhard Trares. Libero. Age 31. Has established himself as a leading figure at 1860 since joining in 1991.

Thomas Miller. Defender. Age 34. One of few survivors from 1860's days in the regional league has proved he can also hold his own in the Bundesliga. Has been out of favour with club managment recently over comments he made to the press.
Matthias Hamann. Defender. Age 29. Reliable defender who gathered Bundesliga experience with Kaiserslautern before joining 1860.
Marco Walker. Defender. Age 26. Swiss player who came to 1860 after gathering experience with several clubs in his homeland including Basel and Lugano. Has one international cap.

Peter Nowak. Midfielder. Age 32. Mercurial player who operates as 1860's main playmaker. Attracted interest from a number of British clubs after running rings round most of the English national side during a World Cup qualifier last year while playing for his native Poland.

Jens Jeremies. Midfielder. Age 23. Coach Werner Lorant regards Jeremies as the best player in the country in his defensive midfield role. Berti Vogts showed he shared Lorant's high opinion by calling up Jeremies for this week's international against Ukraine.

Daniel Borimirov. Midfielder/Forward. Age 27. Lorant sometimes likes to introduce the Bulgarian international as a substitute late in the game, when his impressive skills can leave tired defenders standing.
Manfred Bender. Midfideler/Forward. Age 30. Former Bayern Munich and Karlsruhe striker in his second spell with 1860. Has a wealth of experience and can play in either midfield or striking roles.
Harald Cerny. Forward. Age 23. Austrian international who played for both Admira Wacker and Innsbruck before coming to Munich. Can play as a striker or wide on the flanks.

Bernhard Winkler. Forward. Age 30. Former Kaiserslautern striker has had a sensational season, scoring 17 league goals to put him second in the goalscorers' table. Has been out of action with a groin strain but may be fit for Sunday.
